what: The strategic picture, now that the transfer arm has results: two populations, two arms
derived: 2026-10-30 07:56 UTC, joining docs/METRICS_DEEP_DIVE.md's AUC decomposition to the transfer results

object_gone_5.its_verdict: neither reward channel can reach them -- no shaping term is the lever

what_the_transfer_results_say: The transfer gained +0.2086 on e28 and +0.0428 on e19 -- both in the 'object gone' set the decomposition called unreachable. It was right that no REWARD reaches them and wrong that nothing does: a donor actor changes the policy's competence rather than its reward, which is a different axis entirely. The three remaining object-gone clips are e04, e14 and e25, and e25 is training now.
where_the_biggest_headroom_actually_is: Orientation on clips that already track position well. Five of the nine orientation-limited clips are still unadopted -- e09 e10 e13 e20 e21 -- and the oracle bound is +0.318 each, about +0.053 on the entry mean, which would take Tier 1 AUC from 0.53525 past wte09fl (0.54183) and crisiumnih (0.58226). That is the largest single lever left on any board.
but_the_one_arm_tried_recovered_6_percen: Second-wave arm B4x raised the orientation reward std to 0.8 on those clips. On e00 it gained +0.0206 of AUC and failed MP-SR, so the input-only rule kept the incumbent. +0.02 against a +0.318 oracle is 6% of the available headroom, so the bound is nowhere near achievable with a shaping-std change alone.

droppers_7.evidence: 2 of 2 adopted where the clip loses the object

orientation_limited_5.arm: unknown -- std 0.8 recovered 6% of the oracle, so a better orientation mechanism is needed rather than a tighter std
orientation_limited_5.note: e13 confirms the transfer is the wrong arm here: it gained AUC and lost 25 cm of MPPE

the_honest_conclusion: The cheap, demonstrated arm addresses the smaller headroom, and the larger headroom has no demonstrated arm. That is worth saying plainly: $2.38 finishes the droppers and is worth doing, but the orientation half -- the +0.053 that would actually move Tier 1 AUC several places -- needs a method we do not have, not money.
